meaning: Attests that the authenticated Social post author may link the published place snapshot. It does not attest ownership of the place. The historical claim owner_user_id is bound by Social to ctx.require_user() for the post author, not used to authorize GIS moderation or transfer place ownership.
checks: GIS requires actor and published place in local configured tenant; issuer=infera-places,aud=infera-social,sub/resource_ref=placeID,owner_user_id=requesting actor,120second expiry,uniquejti.
Social CapabilitySecurity verifies configured issuersecret/HS256/audience/issuer/expiry,organization,owner_user_id=authenticated post author,resource_type/ref/sub.
Social persist_capabilities attaches verified snapshot/assertion provenance to the new post; native GIS authority remains separate.
remaining_gates: Actual GIS issuer to Social verifier positive/negative integration with configured signing keys, wrong tenant/author/resource/audience and expiry.
Published-place retirement after assertion issuance, replay policies and deployed issuer-key reconciliation.
Packaged SDK method, readable Manage projection and publication/retention policy.
limits: Source review only; no exploit or deployed compatibility conclusion. No signing key read, created or changed.
